title: onobrychis caput-galli f. depressa
intro: Onobrychis caput-galli f. depressa, commonly known as the yellow salsify, is a perennial plant in the legume family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing the mucous membranes, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Onobrychis caput-galli f. depressa include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
